title: Every document is read by something or deleted
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-15: "wypierdol zbędne docsy, realnie dopieszczaj wszystko po kolei".
Why: docs/ (15 files: adr, program, generated) and instruction files grew across sessions; a document no rule, test, skill or hook reads costs every reader and drifts.
Outcome: every file under docs/ and every agent instruction file is either referenced by a rule, test, skill, hook or AGENTS.md and current, or deleted; superseded ADR text is folded into its successor; a test fails on a docs/ file nothing references.
Files: docs/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, test/rules/
Proof: the reference test passes; byte count of docs/ and instruction files printed before and after.
